notes.title: RELEASE!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42438104/434ffe63c68dd05829c4593ec3a88591a20fde26.png[/img]

The game you've been waiting for is finally here.

It's still early days, so there may be a lot of imperfections.
We'd love to hear your feedback so we can make the game even better.

If you're playing the game and get stuck, or if you need help 
or just want to bash the developers

please visit our discord.
An event is happening in Discord!

Thank you, everyone.

notes.title: Release date confirmed!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42438104/ab030fbebe6b71f5c32a8ee4d233c79cc1c26087.png[/img]

Nice to meet you!

First of all, it's about the release date of the front line.
The release date of 'Isekai Frontline' is February 23, 2023.

And the update of 'Isekai Quest' will be made at the same time as the launch of 'Frontline'.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42438104/c0c67fb951a756dd20d639d979fe01b53e826ade.png[/img]

I have to apologize to those who have been waiting for this year's release.
We released the demo version and listened to various opinions.
As a result, we came to the conclusion that we need to refine this game more and add more touches of our own.

So, we're going to push back the release date that we were aiming for

The release date has been decided as February 23, 2023.

Also, the demo update is scheduled, so I will notify you later.

I will do my best to make the game. Thank you.


If you would like to hear more about our game, please check the link below.

PIXIV: https://www.pixiv.net/users/179685
twitter: https://www.twitter.com/ha_mong2
